title: m/z
summary: The dimensionless spectral coordinate determined by ion mass and charge.
zh_summary: 由离子质量与电荷共同确定的无量纲谱图坐标。

title: Charge state
summary: Read an ion's net charge and understand what isotope spacing can establish.
zh_summary: 读取离子的净电荷，理解同位素峰间距能够提供的证据。

title: Adduct ion
summary: An attached species changes ion composition and the mass correction you need.
zh_summary: 附加物种改变离子组成，也改变反推中性质量所需的修正。

title: Isotopologue
summary: The same molecular entity with a different isotope composition.
zh_summary: 同一分子实体中同位素组成不同的形式。

title: Monoisotopic mass
summary: A specific exact-mass calculation using the most abundant isotope of each element.
zh_summary: 选取各元素丰度最高的同位素所计算的特定精确质量。

title: Mass accuracy
summary: Separate closeness to the target from signed error, precision, and search tolerance.
zh_summary: 区分测量的接近程度、带符号误差、精密度与检索容差。

title: Resolving power
summary: Interpret peak width and separation using an explicit criterion and reference m/z.
zh_summary: 结合明确的判据与参考 m/z，理解峰宽和峰分离能力。

title: Mass analyzer
summary: The instrument component that distinguishes ions by m/z through their motion.
zh_summary: 利用离子运动按 m/z 区分离子的仪器部件。

title: Transient
summary: A finite time-domain ion signal, before frequency analysis and conversion to m/z.
zh_summary: 在频率分析及 m/z 换算之前记录的有限时域离子信号。

title: Precursor ion
summary: The starting ion for a specified reaction, without an assumption of isolation purity.
zh_summary: 指定反应的起始离子；隔离并不保证其化学纯度。

title: Product ion
summary: An ionic reaction outcome, including fragmentation or a change in charge.
zh_summary: 离子反应的带电产物，可以由碎裂或电荷改变形成。

title: Neutral loss
summary: An uncharged species leaves an ion; interpreting the mass gap requires a charge-aware reaction model.
zh_summary: 离子失去不带电物种；解释质量间隔需要考虑电荷及反应模型。

title: Acquisition cycle
summary: A repeated measurement schedule whose duration determines when a channel is revisited.
zh_summary: 重复执行的测量安排，其时长决定何时再次测量某个通道。

title: Isolation window
summary: The precursor m/z interval selected before an MS/MS measurement, with finite selectivity.
zh_summary: 在 MS/MS 测量前选取的前体 m/z 区间，其选择性有限。

title: Extracted ion chromatogram
summary: A time trace from selected m/z signals, with explicit extraction and scan filters.
zh_summary: 从选定 m/z 信号提取的时间轨迹，需要明确提取条件与扫描筛选条件。

title: Feature
summary: A detected LC-MS signal entity, whose grouping is not automatically a molecular identity.
zh_summary: 检测到的 LC-MS 信号实体，其分组并不自动确定分子身份。

title: False discovery rate
summary: An expected error fraction for a defined set of discoveries, not a probability for every hit.
zh_summary: 针对明确定义的发现集合的期望错误比例，并非每条命中的错误概率。

title: Missing value
summary: An unavailable result whose cause and handling require explicit assumptions.
zh_summary: 不可获得的结果，其原因及处理需要明确假设。

title: Mass spectrum
summary: Ion signal plotted against m/z, with a different horizontal axis from a chromatogram.
zh_summary: 离子信号随 m/z 的分布；其横轴与色谱图不同。

title: Base peak
summary: The strongest peak in a spectrum and the denominator for base-peak relative intensity.
zh_summary: 谱图中最强的峰，也是相对于基峰计算强度时的分母。

title: Retention time
summary: Elapsed time from injection to a chromatographic peak maximum, interpreted within a specified method.
zh_summary: 从进样到色谱峰最大值的时间，需要在指定方法内解释。

title: Chromatographic peak
summary: An elution-time signal with a baseline, height, width, and area that need not represent one pure component.
zh_summary: 具有基线、峰高、峰宽与面积的洗脱时间信号，不一定代表单一纯组分。

title: Recovery
summary: Analyte retained through defined preparation steps, separated from matrix-dependent response.
zh_summary: 分析物经过指定前处理步骤后的保留程度，需要与基质相关响应区分。

title: Matrix effect
summary: A response change caused by accompanying sample constituents, distinct from extraction loss.
zh_summary: 伴随样品组分导致的响应变化，与提取损失不同。

title: Carryover
summary: Previously introduced material contributes to a later measurement; impact depends on the next result.
zh_summary: 先前引入的物质对后续测量产生贡献，其影响取决于后续结果的水平。

title: Blank
summary: A control whose contents, treatment, and sequence position define the background question it can answer.
zh_summary: 一种对照，其内容物、处理方式与序列位置决定它能回答哪种背景问题。

title: Calibration curve
summary: A response–quantity relationship used to calculate results within an established range.
zh_summary: 用于在已建立范围内计算结果的响应与量值关系。

title: Internal standard
summary: An added reference substance whose response can track specified shared measurement variation.
zh_summary: 加入的参照物质，其响应可跟踪规定的共同测量变异。

title: Limit of detection
summary: Detection capability defined by a procedure, decision rule, and error probabilities.
zh_summary: 由程序、判定规则及错误概率界定的检出能力。

title: Limit of quantification
summary: The lower level at which specified quantitative performance is supported.
zh_summary: 能够支持规定定量性能的低端水平。

title: Biological replicate
summary: Replication at a stated biological level, whose independence follows the sampling and intervention design.
zh_summary: 在明确生物学层级上的重复，其独立性由抽样及干预设计决定。

title: Batch effect
summary: Systematic technical variation associated with processing groups or acquisition order.
zh_summary: 与处理分组或采集顺序相关的系统性技术变异。

title: Peptide-spectrum match
summary: A proposed spectrum-to-peptide association, distinct from a peptide count or a guaranteed identification.
zh_summary: 提出的谱图与肽段对应关系，不等于肽段计数或确定无误的鉴定。

title: Protein inference
summary: Evaluate parent-protein evidence while retaining shared-peptide ambiguity and protein-group membership.
zh_summary: 评估母体蛋白质证据，同时保留共享肽段歧义和蛋白质分组成员。

title: Proteotypic peptide
summary: A reliably observable peptide in a defined workflow; check sequence specificity separately.
zh_summary: 在明确流程中能可靠观察的肽段；序列特异性仍须单独检验。

title: Post-translational modification
summary: A protein change after translation, distinguished from preparation chemistry, mass-shift hypotheses, and site assignments.
zh_summary: 翻译后发生的蛋白质变化，应与制备化学、质量偏移假设和位点指认区分。

title: Site localization
summary: Determine a modification position using evidence that distinguishes competing placements.
zh_summary: 利用能够区分竞争位置的证据，确定修饰位点。

title: Sequence coverage
summary: The fraction of reference residue positions covered by accepted peptide mappings, counting overlaps once.
zh_summary: 通过筛选的肽段映射所覆盖的参考残基位置比例，重叠位置仅计一次。

title: Molecular formula
summary: Element counts constrain candidates without specifying connectivity or stereochemistry.
zh_summary: 元素数目约束候选物，但不指定连接关系或立体化学。

title: Isomer
summary: The same molecular formula can describe different structures; isobars are a different distinction.
zh_summary: 相同分子式可以对应不同结构；同量异位物种涉及另一种区别。

title: Spectral library
summary: Reference spectra and metadata support comparison without making the top hit automatically correct.
zh_summary: 参考谱与元数据支持比较，但不会使首位命中自动正确。

title: Lipid shorthand notation
summary: Encode the lipid structural details actually established by the experiment.
zh_summary: 编码实验实际建立的脂质结构细节。

title: Ion mobility
summary: Ion motion through gas under an electric field, with coordinate and condition definitions that matter.
zh_summary: 离子在电场作用下穿过气体的运动；坐标和条件定义至关重要。

title: Collision cross section
summary: A model-derived ion–gas collision quantity whose comparability requires specified conditions.
zh_summary: 由模型推导的离子–气体碰撞量；可比性需要明确条件。

title: Crosslinked peptide
summary: A covalently linked peptide product whose chain identities and attachment positions require separate evidence.
zh_summary: 共价连接的肽段产物，其肽链身份和连接位置需要分别提供证据。

title: Crosslink-spectrum match
summary: A proposed spectrum-to-crosslink assignment; its confidence does not automatically transfer to residue or protein pairs.
zh_summary: 候选的谱图与交联对应关系；其置信度不会自动转移到残基对或蛋白质对。

title: Glycopeptide
summary: A peptide carrying one or more glycans, with distinct evidence needs for sequence, composition, and attachment.
zh_summary: 携带一条或多条糖链的肽段，其序列、组成和连接位置各有不同证据需求。

title: Glycoform
summary: A glycoprotein form distinguished by its glycosylation pattern; peptide observations may resolve only part of that pattern.
zh_summary: 由糖基化模式区别的糖蛋白形式；肽段观察可能只解析该模式的一部分。

title: Phosphosite
summary: A residue position bearing a phosphate modification, reported with sequence context and localization evidence.
zh_summary: 携带磷酸修饰的残基位置，应结合序列背景和定位证据报告。

title: Site occupancy
summary: The fraction of an explicitly defined molecular population modified at a specified site.
zh_summary: 明确定义的分子群体中，在指定位点发生修饰的比例。

title: Spatial resolution
summary: Distinguishable spatial detail under a stated criterion, separated from nominal sampling pitch.
zh_summary: 在规定判据下能够区分的空间细节，应与名义采样间距分开。

title: Ion image
summary: A spatial display of selected ion signals whose extraction and display settings define its meaning.
zh_summary: 选定离子信号的空间显示，其含义由提取和显示设置界定。

title: Carrier channel
summary: A higher-input isobaric channel that can assist identification without supplying each cell’s quantitative signal.
zh_summary: 可辅助鉴定的较高输入量等重标记通道，但不提供各细胞本身的定量信号。

title: Limit of blank
summary: An upper boundary for blank results at a specified probability, distinct from detection and quantification capability.
zh_summary: 在规定概率下空白结果的上界，与检出及定量能力不同。

title: Spectral similarity
summary: A comparison score defined by spectral representation, preprocessing, and peak-matching rules; not automatically an identity probability.
zh_summary: 由谱图表示、预处理及峰匹配规则定义的比较分数，不会自动成为身份正确概率。

title: Retention-time prediction
summary: An estimate of an elution coordinate whose scale, local mapping, and applicability depend on chromatography.
zh_summary: 对洗脱坐标的估计，其尺度、本地映射和适用范围依赖色谱条件。

title: Data leakage
summary: Information crosses the boundary intended to make a model evaluation representative of its claimed use.
zh_summary: 信息跨越了用于使模型评估代表其所声称用途的预设边界。

title: Target-decoy competition
summary: Targets compete with constructed decoys under a defined procedure whose assumptions and reporting unit determine valid error control.
zh_summary: 目标与构造诱饵按明确程序竞争，其假设和报告单位决定错误控制是否有效。

title: Controlled vocabulary
summary: Maintained term identifiers and definitions support shared meaning, while units, versions, and context still require validation.
zh_summary: 维护中的术语标识符和定义支持共享含义，而单位、版本和上下文仍需验证。

title: Provenance
summary: The connected history of inputs, transformations, outputs, and responsibility behind a result.
zh_summary: 结果背后相互连接的输入、转换、输出及责任主体历史。

title: Detector
summary: A system converting ions or their electrical influence into observations whose readout convention must be specified.
zh_summary: 将离子或其电学影响转换为观测的系统，需要说明读出约定。

title: Electron multiplier
summary: Secondary-electron amplification, distinct from the choice of analog or pulse-counting readout.
zh_summary: 通过二次电子发射进行放大，与选择模拟或脉冲计数读出是不同问题。

title: Image current
summary: An induced electrical signal from moving charge, without requiring destructive ion impact for each observation.
zh_summary: 运动电荷感应出的电学信号，每次观测不要求离子发生破坏性撞击。

title: Profile spectrum
summary: A spectral representation retaining intensity samples across peaks, without implying an unprocessed detector waveform.
zh_summary: 保留跨谱峰强度采样值的谱图表示，不意味着未经处理的检测器波形。

title: Centroid spectrum
summary: A coordinate–intensity pair for each reported spectral peak, with algorithm-dependent position and intensity meaning.
zh_summary: 为每个报告的谱峰提供坐标与强度对，其位置和强度含义取决于算法。

title: Signal-to-noise ratio
summary: A ratio requiring explicit signal, noise, region, and processing definitions; no universal threshold proves analytical validity.
zh_summary: 需要明确信号、噪声、区域和处理定义的比值；不存在可证明分析有效性的普适阈值。

title: Mass trace
summary: A sequence of compatible m/z observations across scans, used to locate chromatographic structure before assigning chemical meaning.
zh_summary: 把不同扫描中相容的 m/z 观测连接为序列，在赋予化学意义前定位色谱结构。

title: Peak integration
summary: Estimate signal area with explicit boundaries, baseline, coordinate intervals, and numerical method.
zh_summary: 在明确边界、基线、坐标间隔及数值方法的条件下估计信号面积。

title: Retention-time alignment
summary: Transform retention-time coordinates between runs without treating the correction itself as a match or identification.
zh_summary: 变换不同运行之间的保留时间坐标，不把校正本身当作匹配或鉴定。

title: Gap filling
summary: Re-extract existing signal in an expected feature region while preserving how the value was obtained and what remains uncertain.
zh_summary: 从预期特征区域重新提取已有信号，同时保留数值获取方式及尚存的不确定性。

title: Library match
summary: A query–reference comparison accepted under stated rules, with evidence that must remain distinct from an identity claim.
zh_summary: 在明确规则下接受的待查谱图与参考谱图比较，其证据必须与分子身份结论区分。

title: Analog search
summary: A search for related reference compounds, often allowing precursor-dependent fragment shifts, that yields relationship hypotheses.
zh_summary: 寻找相关参考化合物的检索，常允许与前体差相关的碎片位移，结果用于提出关系假说。

title: Molecular network
summary: A graph of spectra or MS-linked features whose edges encode selected comparisons rather than proven structures or reactions.
zh_summary: 由谱图或关联质谱的特征构成的图，边表示选定的比较关系，并非已证实的结构或反应。

title: Ion identity networking
summary: Grouping features as candidate ion forms of the same neutral molecule using chromatographic and ion-mass evidence.
zh_summary: 利用色谱与离子质量证据，将特征分组为可能来自同一中性分子的不同离子形式。

title: Imputation
summary: Model-based estimates for missing entries, with assumptions and uncertainty that remain part of the analysis.
zh_summary: 为缺失单元提供基于模型的估计，其假设与不确定性仍是分析的一部分。

title: Left-censoring
summary: An observation known to be below a justified boundary, rather than an exact value or an unexplained gap.
zh_summary: 只知道某观测低于有依据的界限，而非得到精确数值或原因不明的缺失。

title: Fold change
summary: A ratio relative to a named reference, whose direction, summary, and normalization scale must be explicit.
zh_summary: 相对于指定参照的比值，必须明确方向、汇总方式及归一化尺度。

title: Adjusted p-value
summary: A method-specific significance measure for a defined multiple-testing family, not a finding’s probability of being false.
zh_summary: 针对明确定义的多重检验集合、依赖具体方法的显著性量，并非单项发现为假的概率。
